library.rt_120:r_0aee85115ccb7e1a.text:
The electronic warfare variant of the VF-25 Messiah series. This is its Battroid Mode equipped with the Super Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, Ruuca pilots this unit.
It carries numerous radars and sensors, making it a machine specialized for reconnaissance and electronic warfare.
The head is fitted with a high-performance sensor, and the laser machine guns mounted on the F and S types have been replaced with a high-precision antenna. The weight of the composite radome mounted on its back also works against it, making it unsuited to direct combat, but Ruuca compensates for this lack of combat ability by remotely controlling and guiding the unmanned Ghost QF-4000.
Equipping the Super Pack not only improves its mobility in space but also increases its firepower.

library.rt_120:r_d1821cf899579a4a.text:
The commander's unit of the VF-25 Messiah series. This is the Atmospheric Type of its Fighter Mode, equipped with the Tornado Pack.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, the squad leader $$オズマ$$ pilots this unit.
Compared to other models, its output, firepower, and other performance figures have all been improved, and as a commander's unit it has also been fitted with enhanced communication and command functions as well as a program to assist with command of operations.

library.rt_120:r_1e1f299a3e781af6.text:
This is the Atmospheric Type of the YF-29 $$デュランダル$$'s Fighter Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
$$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
A prototype developed for decisive battle against the Vajra, designed on the basis of the VF-25. Engineers from L.A.I. and the Macross Frontier fleet, among others, took part in its development.
Its greatest feature is that it carries the 'Fold Wave System.' This system uses Fold Quartz gathered from Vajra remains, and enables an almost inexhaustible energy supply. This made it possible to dramatically raise attack power, energy shield capability, and other performance figures far above those of previous machines.
Although a prototype, this unit is equipped with the Super Pack. It consists of Fold Wave projectors at the tips of both wings, chemical rocket boosters at the rear of the inner wings, and other components. Its additional armor is limited to a shield made of laminated energy conversion armor, with the emphasis placed on amplifying the Fold Wave and boosting mobility.
In the atmosphere, the space propellant pods that cover the Super Pack's engine pods are jettisoned.

library.rt_120:r_72560b5c2ff2c6fb.text:
This is the Atmospheric Type of the YF-29 $$デュランダル$$'s Battroid Mode, equipped with the Super Pack.
$$アルト$$ pilots this unit.
A prototype developed for decisive battle against the Vajra, designed on the basis of the VF-25. Engineers from L.A.I. and the Macross Frontier fleet, among others, took part in its development.
Its greatest feature is that it carries the 'Fold Wave System.' This system uses Fold Quartz gathered from Vajra remains, and enables an almost inexhaustible energy supply. This made it possible to dramatically raise attack power, energy shield capability, and other performance figures far above those of previous machines.
Although a prototype, this unit is equipped with the Super Pack. It consists of Fold Wave projectors at the tips of both wings, chemical rocket boosters at the rear of the inner wings, and other components. Its additional armor is limited to a shield made of laminated energy conversion armor, with the emphasis placed on amplifying the Fold Wave and boosting mobility.
When a Battroid equipped with the Super Pack operates within the atmosphere, its heavy equipment normally causes a drop in mobility and melee combat ability. However, this unit maintains its mobility thanks to the high output provided by the Fold Quartz. It also has no parts that restrict the range of motion of its arms or legs, so no drop in melee combat ability is seen either.

library.rt_120:r_51dff9d23924ed59.text:
The $$クァドラン・レア$$ piloted by $$クラン$$.
The squad leader's unit of the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ Pixie Squadron, distinguished by its deep crimson coloring.
It is a remanufactured, technologically updated version of the Queadluun-Rau, the highly mobile aerial combat pod used by female Zentraedi soldiers during the First Interstellar War. Its outward appearance resembles the Rau, but the Rea incorporates functions and equipment that place a greater emphasis on pilot survivability. Its mobility and firepower rival even the latest-model VF-25, and it displays especially outstanding ability in close-quarters combat.
Its armaments include missile launcher pods and Impact Cannons on its back, as well as triple-barrel Gatling laser pulse guns on its arms.

library.rt_120:r_887bcda2cda677f2.text:
The $$シャトル$$ Mode of the VB-6 Koenig Monster.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$カナリア$$ pilots this unit.
Making use of its cargo capacity, it is operated with the aim of rapidly deploying overwhelming firepower. In terms of mobility it falls short of the VF series, but it still demonstrates high flight performance even within the atmosphere.
VB stands for 'VARIABLE BOMBER.' In addition to this mode, it can also transform into a Destroid Mode for melee combat and a Gerwalk Mode for use as a mobile gun platform, giving it three transformable forms just like the VF series.

library.rt_120:r_22a5b8e17f8bad87.text:
The $$シャトル$$ Mode of the VB-6 Koenig Monster.
In $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$カナリア$$ pilots this unit.
Making use of its cargo capacity, it is operated with the aim of rapidly deploying overwhelming firepower. In terms of mobility it falls short of the VF series, but it still demonstrates high flight performance even within the atmosphere.
VB stands for 'VARIABLE BOMBER.' In addition to this mode, it can also transform into a Destroid Mode for melee combat and a Gerwalk Mode for use as a mobile gun platform, giving it three transformable forms just like the VF series.
After the Second Vajra Encounter, $$シェリル$$'s nose art came to be painted on it.

library.rt_120:r_4cb7c77cdb8fc250.text:
An all-purpose space combat carrier that serves as the flagship of $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$
It is the largest combat vessel the private company $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ has been permitted to possess, and its captain is Colonel $$ジェフリー・ワイルダー$$.
True to the name 'Quarter,' its size is roughly one-quarter that of a Macross-class ship, and it has higher mobility than that class. As its 'all-purpose' name suggests, it is capable of Fold navigation, independent descent to a planet's surface, flight within the atmosphere, and travel both on and under water.
It carries numerous weapons, including a Gunship (rapid-fire Buster Cannon), eight Quarter Cannons, anti-ship missiles, and anti-air missile launchers.
It is also capable of transforming into the Assault Type configuration, the greatest characteristic of the Macross-class.

library.rt_120:r_e06a9f9888ae1cc4.text:
The Assault Type configuration of the Macross Quarter.
It transforms from the Fortress Ship Type through the activation of its Transformation sequence.
The Gunship, equipped with a triple rapid-fire Buster Cannon, is mounted on the right arm, while the carrier's flight deck, which also doubles as a shield, is mounted on the left arm.
The Gunship's heavy quantum reaction cannon mode is operated in this configuration. Quarter Cannons are also positioned on the chest and shoulders, allowing firepower to be concentrated to the front.
This configuration also boasts tremendous attack power in close-quarters combat. Its most distinctive attack method is the 'Macross Attack,' in which Pinpoint Barriers are concentrated at the carrier's bow to pierce an enemy ship's armor, after which a Destroid unit is deployed inside.

library.rt_120:r_bf100303e81e1ad9.text:
An unmanned fighter that serves as the main strength of the Galaxy fleet.
Its official designation is $$ＡＩＦ－９Ｖ$$.
Being an unmanned drone, it is not designed with pilot safety in mind, and boasts a level of mobility impossible for a manned machine. However, due to a past incident, restrictions have been placed on the operation of unmanned drones, and the use of this unit, which possesses the highest combat strength of the Ghost series, is severely restricted.

library.rt_120:r_8a8b021f56e57abe.text:
A small trooper-type Vajra.
The most numerous of the Vajra, it mainly acts in the company of larger Vajra.
It has high mobility, and although it has no wings, it can fly even within the atmosphere. It is also capable of biological Fold navigation, albeit only over short distances.
It attacks using pulse beams fired from the crystalline structure of its torso, as well as its anchor-shaped head and whip-like tail.

library.rt_120:r_e65ba7673105a161.text:
A large trooper-type Vajra.
Each swarm numbers anywhere from several thousand to tens of thousands of individuals.
The ram-like protrusion on its back is a bio heavy beam cannon, and the high-output energy it fires rivals that of a space cruiser. It also has an outer shell of energy conversion armor, giving it excellent defensive ability.
It is also agile in its movements, using wing-like organs to operate both in space and within the atmosphere. It is likewise capable of biological Fold navigation over short distances.

library.rt_120:r_333d5ff44619b103.text:
A type of Vajra, also known as the Hound Vajra.
A rare species with fewer individuals compared to other Vajra. It performs a commander-like role and carries out forced reconnaissance. Despite being a large individual, its wings give it extremely high flight ability within the atmosphere.
It fights using a bio heavy beam cannon, biological micro-missiles with tracking capability, and the enormous scythes on its forearms.

library.rt_120:r_fcb6edf80f755525.text:
A Vajra that serves as the flagship within a combat group.
Each group numbers around ten to twenty individuals.
On the battlefield, countless large and small Vajra deploy around it to serve as its escort.
The triple bio heavy quantum beam cannon on its back and elsewhere is extremely powerful, with output rivaling that of a Macross Cannon. It is also equipped with bio energy conversion armor and a field barrier, giving it formidable defensive strength.
It is capable of biological Fold navigation, allowing it to travel across extremely long distances.

library.rt_120:r_bcacd1c68762c345.text:
A Vajra in the form of a combat ship.
Each group numbers roughly several hundred individuals.
It is about the same size as the Macross Quarter, but has high mobility, and travels extremely long distances via biological Fold navigation.

library.rt_120:r_282363406bbb8218.text:
The final Getter Robo, developed for aerial combat.
The Getter Battle Wing on its back generates anti-gravity to enable flight. Its shape changes depending on the situation, for example prioritizing top speed or aerial maneuverability.
It excels at melee combat using the Getter Tomahawk and Getter Scythe, but of the three Shin Getter configurations, only $$真ゲッター１$$ can fire the Getter Beam, the weapon most effective against the Invaders. The beam fired from its abdomen is also more powerful than the one fired from its forehead.
Its ultimate finishing move is Stoner Sunshine, which draws out the power of Getter Rays.

library.rt_120:r_5821bd2f58f4a2d1.text:
The final Getter Robo, developed for ground and underground combat.
It boasts extraordinary speed, and excels at charging tactics using the massive drill mounted on its right arm.
Another characteristic is that nearly all of its techniques, including Drill Missile, Drill Hurricane, and Plasma Drill Hurricane, make use of the drill.

library.rt_120:r_aacfb87aa68dec7f.text:
The final Getter Robo, developed for underwater combat.
Making use of its power, it also displays high combat ability during operations on land.
It is equipped with missiles all over its body: Getter Missiles and Homing Missiles at the shoulders, and Missile Storm at the rear, enabling it to fight at both long and close range.

library.rt_120:r_7b9eeca631285d8e.text:
The final form of Shin Dragon.
$$號$$ had died once, but sensing Kei's crisis, he was revived, evolved Shin Dragon into its final form, and ascended into space.
It possesses a Getter Beam powerful enough to destroy even Jupiter's moon Ganymede in a single blast, and can also transform into Shin Liger and Shin Poseidon. However, this transformation is not achieved by separation and combination, but pivots around the cylindrical section at its center.
Combining its strength with Shin Getter, it succeeded in defeating the colossal Cowen and Stinger, but immediately afterward a rift in spacetime appeared, one large enough to swallow even Pluto.
To stop it, the ultimate weapon, Shin Shine Spark, was activated, sending $$竜馬$$ and the others into the space between time.

library.rt_120:r_697a43b81a6dfea1.text:
A machine built by $$竜馬$$, after being sent forward into the future, by repairing and rebuilding a Getter 1 that had lain decaying on the surface of the moon. It seats one pilot and cannot separate or combine.
It was originally the same color as an ordinary Getter, but its paint was scorched black during atmospheric reentry.
It had its energy absorbed by the awakening Shin Dragon and fell into the sea. It has not appeared since, as $$竜馬$$ subsequently switched to Shin Getter.

library.rt_120:r_11aebec57cec3756.text:
A lower-class Invader active in space.
Its behavioral principles, purpose, and origin are unknown, and since it has no means of communication, it is an enemy that threatens humanity's very survival.
Its intelligence is low, but its aggression is high, and it repeats a cycle of finding prey, devouring it, and reproducing.
The bacteria that are the Invaders' predecessor are single-celled microorganisms also known as fission bacteria. The way they multiply solely through binary fission or endospore formation, and parasitize others to cause fermentation and decay, is precisely the nature of the Invaders themselves.

library.rt_120:r_0ba7919797abd282.text:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It is far larger than the ones that appeared on the ground, and is distinguished by a shape resembling an ancient Earth creature.
It tormented the Getter Team through sheer numbers.

library.rt_120:r_11236840da32cd79.text:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It is far larger than the ones that appeared on the ground, and is distinguished by a shape resembling a marine creature.
It tormented the Getter Team through sheer numbers.

library.rt_120:r_bfdc67887e6c1434.text:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It was large enough to swallow $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ whole, and did not even flinch when struck by a Getter Beam fired from inside it.

library.rt_120:r_7795572676ae602b.text:
An Invader that appeared near Jupiter.
It was large enough to swallow $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ whole, and did not even flinch when struck by a Getter Beam fired from inside it.
It was destroyed from the inside by Shin Getter Liger's drill.

library.rt_120:r_be1c93af378ad23e.text:
A super robot piloted by $$兜甲児$$.
It was built by his grandfather, Juzo Kabuto, is powered by the mysterious super-energy known as photon power, and is armored in Super Alloy Z.
Its cockpit is the small, independently-mobile Hover Pilder, which combines with $$マジンガーＺ$$'s head at the command 'Pilder On!'
Its form calls to mind the image of a god that $$甲児$$ once saw depicted in a book in Juzo's study, and when $$甲児$$ first laid eyes on it, its image overlapped with that of a giant golden god.
With overwhelming power, sturdy defenses, and powerful weaponry equipped all over its body, it battled the Mechanical Beasts sent by Dr. Hell.
This is $$マジンガーＺ$$ equipped with God Scrander, the final and strongest wings that Juzo built from the Arm of Zeus brought back from Bardos Island. When $$マジンガーＺ$$ fell into crisis during the battle with Energer Z, it appeared as if in answer to $$つばさ$$ calling out its name.
Once combined, $$マジンガーＺ$$ not only sees its flight speed and defensive power dramatically improved, but also gains the ability to unleash its ultimate move, Big Bang Punch, transforming itself into a giant fist to deliver a body blow.

library.rt_120:r_173da2d9ac961ba4.text:
A super robot piloted by $$兜甲児$$.
It was built by his grandfather, Juzo Kabuto, is powered by the mysterious super-energy known as photon power, and is armored in Super Alloy Z.
Its cockpit is the small, independently-mobile Hover Pilder, which combines with $$マジンガーＺ$$'s head at the command 'Pilder On!'
Its form calls to mind the image of a god that $$甲児$$ once saw depicted in a book in Juzo's study, and when $$甲児$$ first laid eyes on it, its image overlapped with that of a giant golden god.
With overwhelming power, sturdy defenses, and powerful weaponry equipped all over its body, it battled the Mechanical Beasts sent by Dr. Hell.
This is $$マジンガーＺ$$ equipped with God Scrander, the final and strongest wings that Juzo built from the Arm of Zeus brought back from Bardos Island. When $$マジンガーＺ$$ fell into crisis during the battle with Energer Z, it appeared as if in answer to $$つばさ$$ calling out its name.
Once combined, $$マジンガーＺ$$ not only sees its flight speed and defensive power dramatically improved, but also gains the ability to unleash its ultimate move, Big Bang Punch, transforming itself into a giant fist to deliver a body blow.
Fighting alongside countless Rocket Punches, it defeated Dr. Hell with the Hundred-Shot Rocket Punch, but what awaited it afterward was the worst possible turn of events.

library.rt_120:r_980194cc7bac14d5.text:
The successor to Aphrodai A.
Since it was built from the start as a combat unit, its combat strength is dramatically greater than that of Aphrodai A.
Its appearance was designed based on its pilot, $$さやか$$, herself, and its styling has also been considerably improved.
It is also capable of flight, and in addition to the Photon Power Beam, it is equipped with Super Alloy Z cutters on both arms.
In the final battle it fought valiantly, but was captured by $$ブロッケン$$ V2 Schneider, the Mechanical Beast controlled by $$ブロッケン伯爵$$. Though it fell into a desperate, life-threatening crisis, it escaped danger with support from the Science Fortress Institute.

library.rt_120:r_f2de6f87483c5bda.text:
A former work robot from the Photon Power Lab, remodeled and repainted. It was named $$ボスボロット$$ by $$ヌケ$$ and $$ムチャ$$, a shortening of '$$ボス$$'s Robot.'
Though comical in appearance, it put in noteworthy performances, such as bear-hugging a missile-type Mechanical Beast and hurling it into the sky.
In the final battle, it made a desperate, do-or-die charge at the Mechanical Beast $$あしゅら男爵$$, but was deflected and exploded, leaving only its head intact. Using just its head, it hauled up $$マジンガーＺ$$, which had sunk to the ocean floor, and delivered it to $$甲児$$.

library.rt_120:r_53fb579a37e97273.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 3, 'Sortie! The $$あしゅら$$ Corps!'
A Mechanical Beast controlled by $$あしゅら男爵$$, it emerged from within a Talos statue that had appeared to be disabled.
It used the huge cutter on its head both as a thrown weapon and as a handheld weapon, tormenting $$甲児$$, who was not yet used to piloting $$マジンガーＺ$$.
In the end, it was pierced by a Rocket Punch and then oxidized by Rust Hurricane. After taking the finishing blow, it crumbled into dust.

library.rt_120:r_e54d71caf13fe6df.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 3, 'Sortie! The $$あしゅら$$ Corps!'
A Mechanical Beast controlled by $$あしゅら男爵$$, it emerged from within a Talos statue that had appeared to be disabled.
Its two heads are no mere decoration -- it possesses twice the power of an ordinary Mechanical Beast.
It was defeated by $$マジンガーＺ$$'s Breast Fire.

library.rt_120:r_73eb1a771681aa9f.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 9, 'Activate! Operation Invade Japan!'
In addition to breathing fire, it also delivers powerful attacks with the chained iron balls on both arms. It shrugged off the attacks of the Super Robot corps without effect, and even fought $$マジンガーＺ$$ to a standstill in coordination with Toros D7.
When it tried to ensnare $$マジンガーＺ$$ with its iron balls, it instead lost the contest of strength and was swung around. After being made to collide with Toros D7, it was wiped out along with its ally by Breast Fire.

library.rt_120:r_20390e8eaee24f5e.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, Dr. Hell!'
It stood in the way of $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it headed for a one-on-one duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$.
It excels at attacking with bow and arrow, and the arrows loosed from its bow fly faster than Rust Hurricane.
Working together with fellow Mechanical Beasts, it drove $$マジンガーＺ$$ into a corner, but had its torso pierced by the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$ after it combined with God Scrander.

library.rt_120:r_c6ec3d6fd5f81046.text:
A flying Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 23, 'Closing In! The Mechanical Beast, $$あしゅら男爵$$!'
By spinning the huge fan at the center of its body, it would suck in its opponents and then crush them, an attack with which it wiped out an entire Self-Defense Force fighter squadron.

library.rt_120:r_8573cb1fbab8a2c8.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, Dr. Hell!'
It stood in the way of $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it headed for a one-on-one duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$.
It emitted powerful electromagnetic waves from a device on its shoulder to manipulate gravity, lifting $$マジンガーＺ$$'s body and even seizing control of its Rocket Punch.
Its head was destroyed by the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$ after it combined with God Scrander.

library.rt_120:r_68b10c661826771b.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 9, 'Activate! Operation Invade Japan!'
It could separate its entire body and send the parts flying individually, and used its arm to try to carry off $$マジンガーＺ$$ before it had combined with the Pilder.
It fought underwater against $$甲児$$, who had barely managed to reclaim $$マジンガーＺ$$, and was defeated.

library.rt_120:r_9036855a24953659.text:
A Mechanical Beast that appeared in Episode 24, 'Line of Death! All-Out Attack, Dr. Hell!'
It ambushed $$マジンガーＺ$$ as it arrived at Jikkoku Pass for its duel with $$あしゅら男爵$$, and drove it into a corner in coordination with $$ゴウキューンＵ５$$, Uraa P9, Bamarasu Y1, $$バジンＢ６$$, Abudora U6, Dogura S1, and Magura F2.
In the end, it was destroyed after taking the Rocket Punch of $$マジンガーＺ$$, combined with God Scrander, full in the face.

library.rt_120:r_4fb4590b3b7dd505.text:
A flying fortress piloted by $$ブロッケン伯爵$$.
It has a body massive enough to easily carry the bombardment beast Groizer.
Though shaped like a pterosaur, $$甲児$$ called it a 'big fat pig.'
It sortied even in the final battle, but after $$甲児$$, enraged at seeing his allies struck down, stormed inside it, it lost control and crashed onto the undersea fortress Boodo.
